blind_spots_patched: Original Chapters 3 and 6 missed the post-May-2026 shift out of low-cost Gold-on-Loan into conventional debt, Damas acquisition footnotes (goodwill, bridge loan, initial loss, deferred consideration, and quarterly Ind AS 109 put-option liability remeasurements), and the asymmetric customs-duty reversal risk embedded in ₹943 Cr of H1 FY27 inventory gains.

Original Chapters 3 and 5 overlooked severe gold-price volume elasticity (flat core TMZ buyer growth), 340 bps multi-year consolidated gross margin compression, and grey-market gold inflows pushing domestic bullion to a record discount vs. import parity.

Original Chapter 4 under-analyzed unlisted Aditya Birla Indriya's rapid 100-store FOCO blitz replicating Tanishq's zero-deduction Karatmeter old-gold exchange, Kalyan Jewellers' faster Q2 growth and new-buyer share across 546 showrooms (plus profitable Candere), and the quantified 82% collapse in India's LGD export prices.
assumptions_changed: WEAKENED: Prior ch06 and ch02 stated Q2 FY27 reported PAT of ₹2,393 Cr included a single ~₹536–671 Cr customs-duty/tax adjustment yielding normalized PAT of ₹1,722 Cr (+54% YoY), and listed three negative CFO years (FY20 -₹351 Cr, FY23 -₹1,210 Cr, FY25 -₹465 Cr).

WEAKENED: Prior ch05 stated management guards an 11.5%–12.5% ex-duty jewellery EBIT margin band with Q2 FY27 at ~11.7%, treated 24% jewellery growth as broad volume/brand expansion, and dated beYon's launch to March 2026.
WEAKENED: Prior ch03 assumed elevated borrowings (₹27,638 Cr in Sep 2026) primarily reflected low-cost Gold-on-Lease (1.5%–3.5%) liabilities scaling smoothly with spot gold and store leases.

WEAKENED: Prior ch04 treated Kalyan, Malabar, and Aditya Birla's Indriya as emerging challengers while assuming Tanishq's Karatmeter old-gold exchange and studded franchise insulated domestic share gains.

CONFIRMED: Prior ch02 asserted that CaratLane (+31% YoY), Watches (+27% YoY, ₹412 Cr EBIT), EyeCare (+28% YoY), and narrowing Emerging losses provide resilient multi-engine operating momentum alongside Jewellery.
